_note: Card windows are set from the real reveal ranges in ca3_animation.py GROUPS, not by eye: mossy_fibers 1-85, CA3_deep and CA3_superficial 80-165, thorny_pyramidals 160-250, sparsely_thorny 245-335, inhibitory 330-420. A first pass named the pink CA3 population as thorny cells, which was wrong.

cards.eyebrow: mouse hippocampus CA3 · 1 x 1 x 0.1 mm
cards.title: Mossy fibers first
cards.body: The incoming signal from dentate gyrus. More than 55,000 cross this block, each one carrying the sparse output of a single granule cell.

cards.title: The pyramidal population
cards.body: The cells the mossy fibers drive, arriving by sublayer. 1,815 pyramidal cells were reconstructed in this volume.

cards.title: Thorny pyramidal cells
cards.body: The cells carrying thorny excrescences, the balloon like clusters of spine that a mossy fiber terminal wraps around. A thorny cell takes a median of 48 mossy fiber inputs.

cards.title: Sparsely thorny cells
cards.body: The same class of neuron with far fewer of those spines, and a median of 4 mossy fiber inputs. The two types separate categorically rather than along a continuum.

cards.title: Inhibitory interneurons last
cards.body: Driven by the same mossy fibers, and targeting the pyramidal cells around them. This is feedforward inhibition, and it prefers the thorny cells.
